title: ModdedSummer Modpack
description: This is the Modded Summer modpack. A carefully crafted pack of mods for a balance of adventure and exploration, without breaking the immersion of that classic minecraft feeling. With a focus on user performance, and some QoL features.
body:
Escape to a world of skybound realms, ancient treasures, and botanical magic—without sacrificing that classic Minecraft vibe. Modded Summer blends RPG-style exploration with QoL and performance enhancements, so you can focus on adventure no matter what device you’re on.

Epic Exploration: Venture into the Aether’s floating islands, plunder dungeons with Dungeon Now Loading, and uncover handcrafted landmarks courtesy of Katter’s Structures.

Mythic & Magical: Wield Gaia-powered blooms from Botania, collect relics with Artifacts, and master the dungeons above and below.

Quality-of-Life Boosts:

🛍️ Villager Pickup: Haul trades home with a click

🌳 HT’s TreeChop: Chop an entire tree in one swing

⚡ Easy Mods: Streamlined mob farms, anvil use, enchanting, villager trading, and more!

🔑 Waystones: Create your own teleportation network with a custom config of Waystones

📦 Modern Storage: Includes Tom's Storage, Sophisticated backpacks,

Optimized Performance: Made for smooth framerates across almost all devices.
